9c17dd8cbac153601a3e656994b6ad7a25bdc07c: Hirschegg – Salzstiegl is a low-key resort on a modest scale: 12 km of pistes for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. The family reputation of Hirschegg – Salzstiegl is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The moderate altitude of Hirschegg – Salzstiegl — starting at 1320 m, with the summit at 1740 m — makes it sensitive to climatic variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you set off is strongly advised. At 48€, the day lift pass places Hirschegg – Salzstiegl among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Hirschegg – Salzstiegl does not rival the giants of skiing, and does not pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underestimated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
